{
  # the flake-body rule (2026-10-15): plain sequential simple commands pass,
  # any number of them; logic fails
  outputs = { self }:
    {
      good = pkgs.runCommand "good" { nativeBuildInputs = [ bend ]; } ''
          export HOME=$TMPDIR
          cp -r ${bendSrc}/bend src
          chmod -R u+w src
          mkdir -p $out/bin src/tests/weights
          cp ${./weights/code32k.bpe} src/tests/weights/code32k.bpe
          cd src/tests
          # a comment
          cp -r ${./bend/tests/fixtures} fixtures
          bend Checks.bend suite
          ./dense --threads 4
          cat src/*.bend src/Spec/*.bend > corpus.txt
          bend src/tests/Checks.bend dense-run ${self.x}/bin/x corpus.txt \
            ${./docs/a.md} ${./bend/tests/b.sha256}
          A=1 bend x ''${V:-y}
          set -x
          touch $out
        '';
      and = pkgs.runCommand "and" { } ''
          cp a b && touch $out
        '';
      semi = pkgs.runCommand "semi" { } ''
          cp a b; touch $out
        '';
      or = pkgs.runCommand "or" { } ''
          cp a b || touch $out
        '';
      sub = pkgs.runCommand "sub" { } ''
          (cd src && bend x)
        '';
      cmdsub = pkgs.runCommand "cmdsub" { } ''
          export V=$(cat x)
        '';
      tick = pkgs.runCommand "tick" { } ''
          export V=`cat x`
        '';
      heredoc = pkgs.runCommand "heredoc" { } ''
          cat <<EOF > x
        '';
      if = pkgs.runCommand "if" { } ''
          if cp a b; then touch $out; fi
        '';
      while = pkgs.runCommand "while" { } ''
          while true
          do
            touch $out
          done
        '';
      tool = pkgs.runCommand "tool" { } ''
          sort a > b
        '';
      envtool = pkgs.runCommand "envtool" { } ''
          env LC_ALL=C awk 1 a > b
        '';
      exectool = pkgs.runCommand "exectool" { } ''
          exec grep -q x y
        '';
      test = pkgs.runCommand "test" { } ''
          [ -f x ]
        '';
      midexec = pkgs.runCommand "midexec" { } ''
          exec bend x
          touch $out
        '';
      pipe = pkgs.runCommand "pipe" { } ''
          bend x | tee y
        '';
      bg = pkgs.runCommand "bg" { } ''
          bend x &
        '';
    };
}
